# Example CLI dump, written by hand as a test fixture.
# Not from a real aircraft. Deliberately contains several of the mistakes
# the review command looks for.

# diff all

# version
# Betaflight / STM32F405 (S405) 4.4.2 Jun  5 2023 / 06:31:34 (7c5770c1c)

board_name MATEKF405
manufacturer_id MTKS

# feature
feature -RX_PARALLEL_PWM
feature RX_SERIAL
feature TELEMETRY
feature AIRMODE

# serial
serial 0 64 115200 57600 0 115200

# master
set gyro_lpf1_static_hz = 250
set gyro_lpf2_static_hz = 500
set dyn_notch_count = 3
set dyn_notch_q = 300
set dyn_notch_min_hz = 100
set dyn_notch_max_hz = 400
set rpm_filter_harmonics = 3
set dshot_bidir = OFF
set motor_poles = 14
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT600
set failsafe_procedure = DROP
set gyro_to_use = FIRST

profile 0
set p_roll = 45
set i_roll = 80
set d_roll = 40
set d_min_roll = 30
set p_pitch = 47
set i_pitch = 84
set d_pitch = 46
set d_min_pitch = 34
set p_yaw = 45
set i_yaw = 80
set d_yaw = 0
set dterm_lpf1_static_hz = 145
set dterm_lpf2_static_hz = 145
set feedforward_transition = 0

rateprofile 0
set rates_type = ACTUAL
set roll_rc_rate = 12
set pitch_rc_rate = 12
set yaw_rc_rate = 12
set roll_expo = 0
set roll_srate = 67

save
